final: WITH t AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws),''),'') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_award a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, cnt, cnt*1.0/(SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM t) AS share FROM t), m AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_tally, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share_of_kept, AVG(s.share - m.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, m WHERE s.share > m.avg_share
